highlights:
## Nod stays on when you close it 🌙

Closing the window or pressing ⌘Q now closes the app, not Nod. Nod keeps running in the menu bar or tray, so schedules and Telegram or WhatsApp replies keep working. To stop it, choose **Turn Off Nod**. If something would stop, Nod tells you first.

With **Open at login**, Nod starts in the background when you sign in. It restarts itself if it stops unexpectedly, and installs updates while idle.

**Keep this computer awake when plugged in** is new in **Settings → General**, on by default. With a schedule or a connected channel, a plugged-in computer won't sleep when left idle. Closing the lid still sleeps.

## Sign in on the website's own page 🔐

When a task needs a login you haven't saved, you sign in on the website's real page in the **Browser** panel, with its real address.

## Also in this release

- **Faster chat:** replies come back sooner, and longer research runs as a task.
- **Easier to read:** clearer replies, fixed choice cards, and links to check a booking or order.
- **Quiet notifications:** silent by default. Turn on **Play a sound** in **Settings → Notifications**.
- **Online orders:** Nod tries to continue the same order when you follow up.
- **Setup:** Nod repairs damaged files that left it stuck at **Preparing your browser…**.
- **Computer use:** no confirmation when Nod only adds text, and apps such as Thunderbird work.
